[08/09/2026, 18:20] Wanjiru: Hello, I saw your HP EliteBook 840 G5 post. I'm in Dallas but buying it for my brother in Nairobi
[08/09/2026, 18:24] Otieno: Hi, yes still available. Core i5, 8GB RAM, 256GB SSD
[08/09/2026, 18:25] Wanjiru: Since I'm paying from the US, can you quote in dollars?
[08/09/2026, 18:27] Otieno: $320 then
[08/09/2026, 18:29] Wanjiru: Ok $320 works. Does it come with the charger?
[08/09/2026, 18:30] Otieno: Yes original HP charger included
[08/09/2026, 18:32] Wanjiru: My brother is in South B. Can a rider bring it to him?
[08/09/2026, 18:33] Otieno: Sure, I'll send a boda guy, he'll have it by Saturday
[08/09/2026, 18:34] Wanjiru: Great, thanks
notes: Relative date: diaspora buyer paying in USD; 'by Saturday' on Tue 8 Sep resolves to deliver_by 2026-09-12.
